early_warning.dispatcher_action_next_tick: PRE-DECLARED LOAD-SHED CRITERION: at the ~06:18Z chef-intraday tick the dispatcher will re-read swap BEFORE spawning. If free swap is still critically low (<~700MB) or total stays pinned at the cap, the dispatcher will WITHHOLD the heavy CHEF spawn (load-shed) and document the skipped slot — refusing to be the straw that re-crashes the VM. If swap recovers (it has been volatile this session), spawn normally. This extends the existing slot-lock Error Guard from 'withhold on dead gateway' to 'withhold on host-exhaustion that the spawn would tip over'.

This is the residual risk explicitly flagged at the 04:48Z incident resolution, now materializing worse than at resolution.
